{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Pale blue blouse: classic fit, long sleeves, hip-skimming length, soft blue #c9d9e8, matte crepe
Straight-leg trousers: high-rise, ankle-length, deep navy #2b3a55, wool blend
Textured blazer: single-breasted, slightly tailored, hip length, grey-blue #8a94a6, herringbone wool tweed
Loafers: classic almond toe, low block heel, charcoal #3a3d45, smooth leather
Slim belt: narrow, with a small silver buckle, charcoal #3a3d45, smooth leather
Structured tote bag: medium size, top handles, taupe-grey #9a9298, grained leather
Small hoop earrings: thin, polished silver tone #c0c0c0, metal

This outfit sits squarely in neat office dress: a blouse with trousers, a textured jacket and loafers. The soft blue of the blouse echoes her eye color and, together with navy and grey-blue, forms a cool palette that flatters her fair skin and silver hair without looking harsh. The high-rise straight trousers and the tailored jacket give a clean, elongated line, and the belt defines the waist. The tweed adds autumn texture and warmth, while the muted tones keep everything easy to wear through a working day."}
